images.filename: On the way up Goatfell from Corrie - geograph.org.uk - 845474.jpg
images.caption: On the way up Goatfell from Corrie Quite a clear day, so the island of Bute is visible top left of the photo, with the big and wee Cumbrae islands to the right of that.  The Ayrshire coast lies behind, about 20Km away.
images.alt: On the way up Goatfell from Corrie Quite a clear day, so the island of Bute is visible top left of the photo, with the big and wee Cumbrae islands to the right of that.  The Ayrshire coast lies behind, about 20Km away.

images.filename: The final ascent - geograph.org.uk - 845457.jpg
images.caption: The final ascent Behind lies Goatfell summit.  Ahead, the path splits - right to Brodick, and straight on then left to Corrie.  The Corrie path crosses the burn to the left of the photo and can be seen in the distance on the far bank.  The Ayrshire coast can be seen faintly in the distance.
images.alt: The final ascent Behind lies Goatfell summit.  Ahead, the path splits - right to Brodick, and straight on then left to Corrie.  The Corrie path crosses the burn to the left of the photo and can be seen in the distance on the far bank.  The Ayrshire coast can be seen faintly in the distance.
